from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background={v for v,n in counts.most_common(2)}
    out=[[0]*(w//3) for _ in range(h//3)]
    for br in range(h//3):
        for bc in range(w//3):
            vals={grid[r][c] for r in range(br*3,br*3+3) for c in range(bc*3,bc*3+3) if grid[r][c] not in background}
            if len(vals)==1: out[br][bc]=next(iter(vals))
    return out
